title: INSTR (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT POSITION('br' IN 'The broken brown briefcase') AS Position, CHARINDEX('br','The broken brown briefcase',6) AS Charindex, $FIND('The broken brown briefcase','br',6) AS Find, INSTR('The broken brown briefcase','br',6,2) AS Inst
SELECT INSTR('The quick brown fox','b',1) AS PosInt
SELECT Name, INSTR(Name,',',1)-1 AS LNameLen FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name, INSTR(%SQLUPPER(Name),'B',1)-1 AS BPos FROM Sample.Person
